mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_profile ( user_id, spicy_level, flavor_pref, dietary_restrictions, travel_pace, budget_per_meal ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{spicyLevel}, #{flavorPref}, #{dietaryRestrictions}, #{travelPace}, #{budgetPerMeal} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE spicy_level = VALUES(spicy_level), flavor_pref = VALUES(flavor_pref), dietary_restrictions = VALUES(dietary_restrictions), travel_pace = VALUES(travel_pace), budget_per_meal = VALUES(budget_per_meal), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
